## Appearance

Phil Gordon has big brown eyes and a crooked smile. Her features are defined by brown tints, and her hair is worn in curls.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Interlude P5](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0005), [v3 ch.Confidences P3](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0003)_

## Personality

A charming and playful individual, this loyal person describes her own life mission as being one to charm and allure. Though unselfish and free from any form of snobbishness, she can be a bit thoughtless and possesses an indecisive nature. She has deft fingers that allow her to create impressive dresses through embroidery, and she excels in mathematics with the goal of winning a scholarship. Additionally, she has learned household skills like sweeping floors and washing dishes, while harboring a strong horror of scarlet fever and a desire to prompt a man named [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) to ask for her hand in marriage.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Place P65](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0065), [v3 ch.Relationships P66](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0066), [v3 ch.Interlude P22](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0022), [v3 ch.Speaks P7](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0007), [v3 ch.Jonas P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001), +3 more_

## History

Philippa "Phil" Gordon, the daughter of a wealthy man from an old [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) family, met [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) during her first day at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), where they quickly bonded over shared homesickness. Phil became a central member of the friend group, joining [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) in renting Patty's Place alongside [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md) and [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md). Though initially courted by numerous suitors back home and pursued by men at college, Phil's life took a major turn during a summer at [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point). There, she met [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/blake.md), a theological student whose moving sermon earned her deep admiration. Phil accepted Jonas's marriage proposal later that school year, choosing him over her wealthy suitors. Throughout their time at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Phil served as a close confidante to [Anne](../character/anne.md), comforting her through her complicated romantic trials, including her rejection of [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md). After completing her time at college, Phil celebrated her wedding with her friends in attendance.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P4](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0004), [v3 ch.Lady P9](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0009), [v3 ch.Lady P13](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0013), [v3 ch.Lady P16](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0016), [v3 ch.Lady P22](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0022), [v3 ch.Lady P25](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0025), +576 more_

## Quotes

> "Heaps. The boys like me awfully—they really do. But there were only two that mattered. The rest were all too young and too poor. I must marry a rich man, you know."
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Lady P50](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0050)

> "And let me come to see you. I want to be chummy with you. I’ve taken such a fancy to you both. And I haven’t quite disgusted you with my frivolity, have I?"
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Lady P60](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0060)

> "I’ll go, if I can walk with Priscilla and Charlie. That will be a bearable degree of gooseberry. That Gilbert of yours is a darling, Anne, but why does he go around so much with Goggle-eyes?"
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Park P9](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0009)

> "I don’t want William’s Island especially, but I’m sure I couldn’t get it if I did. Look at that sentry on the summit of the fort, right beside the flag. Doesn’t he look as if he had stepped out of a romance?"
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Park P25](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0025)

> "Look—in white letters, around the archway over the gate. ‘Patty’s Place.’ Isn’t that killing? Especially on this Avenue of Pinehursts and Elmwolds and Cedarcrofts? ‘Patty’s Place,’ if you please! I adore it."
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Park P34](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0034)

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--phil-gordon.md)

Phil and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) met on their first day at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) while sitting on a gravestone in Old St. John's Cemetery, striking up an immediate friendship over their shared homesickness. ### [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jonas--phil-gordon.md)
